name: smwsprites-strollin-stu
title: Strollin' Stu
description:
Strollin' Stus are squat, pudgy creatures, somewhat similar to Goombas, that are native to Isle Delfino. They have bulbous noses, high-tucked spotted trousers, and a waddling gait.

This sprite was originally part of andy_k_250's Custom Tweaked Sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards. They were made as a demo of the ability for mikeyk's Spritetool (also inherited by PIXI) to create tweaked copies of vanilla sprites without altering the vanilla sprites themselves, via a .cfg file that does not reference an .asm file at all. Therefore, the lack of .asm files in this download is not only intentional, it is the main idea.
